'''Hepswick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] corporal who resided on the war torn [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She made her living as a light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] vendor.
